overview_description.description:
Okteto is a computer software company that specializes in the fields of software development, software engineering, and the cloud computing industry. The company allows to Iinstantly spin up pre-configured environments in the cloud and start developing within seconds.

Okteto was founded in 2018 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

about_short_description.short_description: Okteto specializes in the fields of software development, software engineering, and the cloud computing industry.

product.name: Okteto Development Environments
product.description: A platform that automates the creation of Kubernetes-based development environments, enabling developers to code in production-like settings with instant feedback and minimal setup time.

product.name: Okteto Preview Environments
product.description: Automated environments that deploy code changes for every pull request, enabling teams to test and collaborate on live, production-like instances before merging.

product.name: Okteto Enterprise
product.description: A self-hosted solution that runs on an organization's Kubernetes infrastructure, providing scalable, secure, and policy-driven development environments with advanced access control and resource management.

product.name: Okteto CLI
product.description: A command-line interface tool that enables developers to create and manage cloud-native development environments on Kubernetes clusters from their local machines.

product.name: Okteto Test
product.description: A testing service that integrates with existing testing frameworks to run tests directly in Kubernetes development environments, ensuring consistency between development and production.
